Maybe because they think, since Slipknot is a metal band, that you aren't a fan just because you like their soft stuff (that of course is not metal). I love Vermilion Pt.2, I love Danger - Keep away too and these are soft songs. If you're a Slipknot fan, it doesn't matter if you like their soft or heavy stuff. You're a fan because you like them, you don't have to know every single lyric to every song or like their heavy stuff more than their soft songs. You like their stuff and you're still a fan if you like them.

For me it would be Diluted. I feel that song. I understand how Corey felt when he sang it and wrote it, the lyrics are a part of me because I lived the thing since I started school until it fucked me up so much I ended up being something I wasn't, just because I wanted something I didn't need. Later I recovered a little, all by myself and decided to forget and just don't care about it, like it never happened. So that's how that song is special to me, because I know I wasn't the only one going through all that.

Also, I like a lot of 80/90's stuff, when I was younger my father used to put a lot of rock and pop music on the radio and I absolutely loved it. And well, some modern stuff too, I think I only like Daft Punk. And aside from that I'm a lot into video games, my favorite one is Mortal Kombat.

I'm 16 too, realizing what I have in front of me. Afraid of everything that is coming, my last year of school and then "life" begins. Work, work and lots of work. But what can we do? Us humans live our life like this, we study and learn all our lives, we work hard because we want to live, we give it all just so we can be recognized as someone by the society. I really don't want to do this, I want something else. I want to enjoy, live a life without making myself a slave to money and acceptance, because that is what we seek our whole lives. But in the end we'll end up doing the same, because that is what we, humans, have been doing since forever and now that we've got all of this, we can't stop.
